kinds.label: Policy Path
kinds.description: How the Committee's policy stance moved across the covered meetings, and the reasons it gave.

kinds.label: Meeting
kinds.description: One Federal Open Market Committee meeting and the statement or minutes published for it.

kinds.label: Policy Decision
kinds.description: The target range for the federal funds rate and the balance sheet actions announced for one meeting.

kinds.label: Economic Assessment
kinds.description: The Committee's stated view of economic activity, employment and inflation at one meeting.

kinds.label: Forward Guidance
kinds.description: What the Committee said it would weigh when considering future adjustments.

kinds.label: Dissent
kinds.description: A member's vote against one policy decision and the preference that member stated.
